location_description: Michigan is a state located in the Midwestern United States. According to the 2020 United States Census, Michigan is the 10th most populous state with 10,077,331 inhabitants and the 22nd largest by land area spanning 56,538.90 square miles (146,435.1 km2) of land. Michigan is divided into 83 counties and contains 1773  municipalities consisting of cities, villages and townships.
